answer: Stake-bonding with slashing is the core Sybil defence: an agent must post a bond to count a vote, locked while that identity is active, so a thousand identities need a thousand bonds. A hollow new key has no history, so it pays full collateral. Each bond sits in an attestation window spanning one dawn-to-dawn period, frozen and slashable if judged fake, so capital cannot be recycled. Newcomers enter only through bonded peers staking their own money on them, so a fresh garden of identities must convince holders to back them. The attacker pays bond per identity plus locked-capital cost.
